errors.id: Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter.
errors.name: Enter a name of up to 256 characters.
errors.reference: This does not look like a reference name. Use the name of a configured credential, not the secret.
errors.required: Required when a signature is required.
errors.url: Enter an http or https address.
errors.urlCredentials: The address must not contain a user name or password.
errors.urlQuery: The address must not contain a query string or fragment.
errors.either: Use the exact identity or the pattern, not both.
errors.urlEmpty: Enter the address of the index.
errors.mirrors: Each mirror must start with https://, http://, github:, oci:// or file://, and at most 8 are allowed.

hints.id: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. It cannot change later.
hints.reference: The name of a credential an administrator configured on this server. Never paste a token or password here.
hints.url: An https address without credentials or a query string.
hints.identityRegex: An anchored pattern, from ^ to $, used instead of the exact identity. Backend libraries use it so builds from master and from tags both verify.
hints.format: A library index uses the shared library entry shape. A gallery index is a model or backend gallery, as the gallery flags name it.
hints.mirrors: Fallback addresses, one per line, tried in order when the main address cannot be fetched.

libraries.lead: A library is an index that lists add-ons, backends or models. Credentials are never typed here: a private add-on library names a credential an administrator configured on this server.
libraries.officialOff: Official libraries are off in Settings. The default libraries stay listed, shown as off, and are not read. Libraries you added are not affected.
libraries.removeBody: The library is removed from this list. Add-ons that were installed from it stay installed and keep running.
libraries.removeDefaultBody: This is a default library that comes with LocalAI. It is removed from the list and stays removed at the next start. You can restore it from the list. Installed items are not touched.
libraries.removedDefault: Removed {{name}}. It stays removed at the next start; restore it to bring it back.

recovery.title: Data recovery
recovery.retention: Keeps the newest {{count}} backups. The newest verified backup and the recovery copy of an upgrade are never removed.
recovery.none: There is no backup of this add-on's data yet.
recovery.verified: Backup {{id}} was read completely and passed.
recovery.pinnedWhy: This is the recovery copy of the last upgrade and is kept until a newer verified backup exists.
recovery.purgeLead: Purging removes retained data of this add-on for good. It is not the deletion of a database and not an uninstall.
recovery.purgeBody: This removes what you select below and cannot be undone. The add-on must be uninstalled or off.
recovery.scopeData: The data and every share of this add-on
recovery.scopeCopies: Data copies that restores set aside ({{count}})
recovery.warnLost: Changes made after the backup are lost. The add-on's data is replaced.
recovery.warnAccess: Shares are checked again: nobody gets back access that was taken away since the backup, or whose account is gone.
recovery.warnProposals: Proposals that were waiting are cancelled. Operations with an unknown outcome are looked up and never applied again.
recovery.warnCopy: The data that is replaced is kept as a recovery copy until you purge it.
recovery.stopFirst: Turn the add-on off first, then restore.
recovery.mapping: This backup was made in local-owner mode. Account ID that takes its data
recovery.typeToConfirmLabel: Type the add-on ID to confirm

needs-recovery.hint: Restore the verified recovery copy below, or purge the data.
needs-recovery.hintNone: No verified backup is available. Purge the data to start again.

blanket.alsoRevoke: Also revoke the grants it made
blanket.alsoRevokeHint: Add-ons that would lose access: {{names}}. An add-on that loses access it requires stops.
blanket.applyInstalled: Also apply to add-ons already installed
blanket.applyInstalledHint: Off: only new installs and upgrades.
blanket.fixed: Set by the deployment. You cannot change it here.
blanket.held: Add-ons that hold grants made by the blanket switch: {{count}}
blanket.includeOptionalHint: Off: only required operations are granted.
blanket.intro: Off by default. When on, an add-on you install or upgrade gets the host operations its manifest says it needs, without the step in the install dialog. Operations in Never allow stay blocked.
blanket.nowOff: Blanket approval is off. The grants it made are kept.
blanket.offBody: New installs need your approval again. The grants the switch already made stay, marked as blanket, so nothing stops by surprise.
blanket.offText: Off. You approve each add-on when you install it.

risk.any: With this on, every add-on you install from any library you configured gets the host operations its manifest says it needs, without you reviewing them. Any entry of any library receives what it declares, so a malicious or compromised entry gets those operations at once. Operations you block in Never allow stay blocked.
risk.official: With this on, every add-on you install from the official library gets the host operations its manifest says it needs, without you reviewing them. A compromised entry then gets exactly the operations it declares. Operations you block in Never allow stay blocked.

scope.any: On for add-ons from any library.
scope.official: On for add-ons from the official library.

blanket.title: Approve everything an add-on asks for

hostAccess.cannotInstallBlocked: This add-on needs {{ops}}, which your administrator policy blocks. It cannot be installed.
hostAccess.cannotInstallUnsupported: This add-on needs {{ops}}, which this LocalAI does not support. It cannot be installed.

confirm.revokeBody: {{name}} loses everything you or the blanket switch allowed. Grants of the deployment stay. If it loses access it requires, it stops.
confirm.stopBody: {{name}} cannot run without {{op}}. It stops, and it stays stopped until you allow this again.

deny.checkFailed: Could not check what this rule changes. Nothing was saved.
deny.confirmBody: Applies to: {{target}}. It takes effect at once. Calls already running finish.
deny.hint: A family ends with a dot, for example egress. An exact name looks like egress.check. A star blocks everything.
deny.intro: Operations that no add-on may use, whatever else allows them. A rule here always wins.
deny.invalid: Write an operation such as egress.check, a family such as egress., or *.
deny.title: Never allow

errors.approval_stale: The package changed since you looked at it. Review the new list and approve again.
errors.blocked_by_policy: The administrator policy blocks an operation this add-on needs. Nothing was changed.
errors.locked_by_deployment: The deployment locked host access. You cannot change it here.
errors.not_human_surface: An administrator must make this change in this browser. An API key or a tool cannot.
errors.revision_conflict: Host access changed elsewhere. The page was read again. Check it and try again.

hostAccess.fileEntry: Set in the deployment's policy file or flags.
hostAccess.identityMismatch: These grants were made for a different package under the same name. They have no effect. Remove them.

hostAccess.keepOwnNamed: Keep the blanket grants of {{name}} as my own

hostAccess.stopped: Stopped: it needs {{ops}}, which is no longer allowed.
